oai_dc:dc.dc:title: Towards Greater Success for Working Students: Policy Considerations for Institutions of Higher Education
oai_dc:dc.dc:creator: Remenick, Lauren
oai_dc:dc.dc:description: The majority of college students today work at least part-time. Policy leaders view employment as a way for students to gain skills that can be used when they enter the workforce. Yet most university policies serve traditional students and make few accommodations for working students.Within this policy brief I consider why students work, the benefits and drawbacks of student employment and how institutions can adjust their policies to make a more welcoming environment for working students. Universities that best serve working students will succeed in enrolling, retaining, and graduating a more diverse population of students - a win for all involved in higher education.
